pages.title: Conta da hospedaria
pages.layout: wide inn scene with a small ledger detail
pages.scene: Hessa LEFT at her inhabited river-port inn counter records six beds, supper and stable fees; Adra RIGHT lays the approved travel purse beside the ledger. Ochre lamps, occupied rooms, real costs.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: Seis camas, jantar e estábulo. Registro tudo.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: A viagem tem verba. Ninguém lhe deve trabalho grátis.

pages.title: Um porto vivo
pages.layout: wide exterior through inn window with intimate foreground
pages.scene: Hessa LEFT opens the inn window toward several inhabited human, orc and gnome homes with lit windows; Ilyan RIGHT, long black waves and no beard, listens rather than assuming this is an abandoned town.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: O cais grande morreu. As famílias ficaram.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: O mapa apagou o nome, não as pessoas.

pages.title: A segunda barca
pages.layout: arrival panorama plus cord detail
pages.scene: Adult gnome Pim LEFT, red head scarf and copper-gray beard, steps from the second supply barge carrying a wrapped old measuring cord; Adra RIGHT checks the cargo list at the occupied west-bank quay.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: Trouxe a fita antiga e os mantimentos.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Agora podemos medir sem inventar distância.

pages.title: A base guardada
pages.layout: asymmetric shed scene and object inset
pages.scene: Pim LEFT shows the preserved weathered base of the first stake inside Hessa's dry shed; Caio RIGHT, short reddish brown curls and warm brown skin, compares it with the new oak replacement outside.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: A primeira estaca foi trocada. A base ficou aqui.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Vou marcar antiga e nova em colunas separadas.

pages.title: Lama sobre a segunda
pages.layout: wide public bank with mud detail
pages.scene: Pim LEFT points to the second stake buried under river mud from a safe public-bank plank; adult half-orc Tovo RIGHT, sage-green skin and broad shoulders, sets a survey marker without using amplified strength.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: A segunda está debaixo da lama.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Então ninguém vai puxá-la só para ganhar tempo.

pages.title: A terceira distância
pages.layout: two depth planes with stake in distance
pages.scene: Adra LEFT reads the current shoreline on the authorized map; Runa RIGHT with straight black fringe, septum ring and left floral tattoo holds the measured tape toward the third exposed stake, which appears displaced relative to Ereno's drawing.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Pela margem de hoje, a terceira não coincide.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Ainda falta testar a linha antiga de cascalho.

pages.title: A linha atrás da casa
pages.layout: broad landscape and narrow tape inset
pages.scene: Hessa LEFT leads Runa RIGHT to the dry gravel line behind the inn, once a former riverbank; Runa measures toward the third stake and sees the old drawing align without claiming a culprit.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: Antes da obra, a água vinha até este cascalho.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Daqui o desenho de Ereno volta a fechar.

pages.title: O erro que pode voltar
pages.layout: dynamic action with clear retreat space
pages.scene: Caio LEFT accidentally curls dust around the tape at the gravel line, then drops his hand to stop; Sere RIGHT, dark-skinned elf archer with amber eyes, keeps the line clear and does not let dust hit Pim.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: Soltei a fita antes de atingir alguém.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: A medida se refaz. Um olho, não.

pages.title: A pedra-limite
pages.layout: wide boundary panorama with stone detail
pages.scene: Talin LEFT, adult female elf with short curly copper-red hair, freckles and a fine scar on her right cheek, meets a different female elf guardian RIGHT at the public boundary stone; behind them the protected woodland stays distinct from the public path.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: A licença termina nesta pedra.

lines.speaker: Guardiã
lines.text: Só eu atravesso para consultar Ysra.

pages.title: Sem convite oculto
pages.layout: single clearing panel with tiny fairy detail
pages.scene: Sere LEFT calmly stops Ilyan RIGHT at the marked public clearing while willow fairies hover over water at a distance; no one follows them into protected trees.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: As fadas não são guias da nossa licença.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Eu fico. Uma pergunta não abre trilha.

pages.title: O livro da família
pages.layout: quiet candlelit ledger scene
pages.scene: Hessa LEFT opens her father's old account book at her inn table at night; Adra RIGHT requests permission to examine one winter ledger page without removing it.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: O livro fica comigo. Podem ler esta folha.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: E a cópia só sai com seu consentimento.

pages.title: A inicial ambígua
pages.layout: close ledger foreground and two faces
pages.scene: Hessa LEFT indicates a handwritten entry marked M. de Pedra-Mansa beside three boards, a lantern and a glass case; Ilyan RIGHT studies the line with restrained hope, no invented image of Mira.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: M. pode ser Mera, Maris ou Mira.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Vou guardar a dúvida junto com a data.

pages.title: Cópia permitida
pages.layout: document detail with hands and faces separate
pages.scene: Adra LEFT uses approved light-sensitive paper to copy the open ledger in Hessa's presence off frame; Runa RIGHT sketches its watermark so a later examiner can compare, without taking the book.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Cópia autorizada. A folha não sai daqui.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Também marquei a filigrana do papel.

pages.title: Antes do nevoeiro
pages.layout: domestic port scene with supply detail
pages.scene: Hessa LEFT sends a paid porter to check the upper lane while Tovo RIGHT sorts dry lanterns and food at the occupied inn; routine preparation shows the day between the survey and the strange fog.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: Hoje revemos a trilha e os quartos.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: E deixamos uma saída livre para todos.

pages.title: Pedido aos guardiões
pages.layout: boundary scene with paper inset
pages.scene: Adra LEFT hands Talin RIGHT a written request for Ysra to explain old stones at the public boundary; Talin keeps the sealed request and the party stays outside.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Pedimos explicação, não passagem.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Vou levar isso. Esperem deste lado.

pages.title: Duas distâncias
pages.layout: uncanny wide canal with ribbon inset
pages.scene: At the dry channel edge, Tovo LEFT hears Hessa's distant stable hammer seem near and far at once; Caio RIGHT raises a ribbon that catches opposing real breezes at ground and hand height.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: O martelo soa daqui e de outra rua.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: O ar corre em sentidos opostos.

pages.title: Árvores que não estão ali
pages.layout: large reflection panel and restrained figures
pages.scene: Sere LEFT halts the group at the safe bank; Runa RIGHT observes shallow water reflecting trees absent from the physical bank and a translucent deer image, without stepping into channel.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Ninguém entra no canal.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Essas copas não pertencem a esta margem.

pages.title: A emissária chega
pages.layout: arrival panorama with two foreground speakers
pages.scene: Ysra LEFT, adult fae with earthy brown skin and entirely gold eyes, arrives along the authorized public path accompanied by an elf guardian in background; Adra RIGHT repeats the written limits before any talk of the channel.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Repita os limites antes de me mostrar a água.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Trilha pública, estacas expostas e três pedras.

pages.title: Costura, não porta
pages.layout: single scene with reflection occupying lower half
pages.scene: Ysra LEFT points from safe dry ground to water reflecting a second landscape; Ilyan RIGHT listens, sword sheathed, no portal crossing or shadowless door.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: O canal é uma costura, não uma entrada.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Ver o outro lado não nos faz atravessar.

pages.title: Pesos antigos
pages.layout: stone foreground and faces above
pages.scene: Ysra LEFT shows Runa RIGHT an ancient basalt weight with later tool marks at a safe distance; layered roots and masonry suggest different communities maintained it across eras.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Elfos, gnomos, fadas e humanos ajustaram isto.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: As marcas recentes ainda não têm autor.

pages.title: O mundo junto da água
pages.layout: wide water-glass reflection with speakers foreground
pages.scene: Ysra LEFT describes the inhabited Entremeio while Tovo RIGHT looks toward reflected reed houses and water-glass groves without entering; show living communities as distant reflection, not threatening army.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Há aldeias e caminhos próprios no Entremeio.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: Então ninguém daqui pode chamá-lo de vazio.

pages.title: O Fundo de Sal
pages.layout: atmospheric landscape with dark distant salt bank
pages.scene: Ysra LEFT names the darker salt banks beyond the reflected reed houses; Sere RIGHT hears that some predators there seek warmth, while the rest of the magical world remains separate.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: O Fundo abriga caçadores de calor e carne.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Isso não torna maligno todo o Entremeio.

pages.title: A história de Pim
pages.layout: oral-history foreground with sepia inset
pages.scene: Pim LEFT recounts ancestral fishermen removing a seam weight in a drought; Talin RIGHT checks which details are family memory, with three small boat silhouettes only in a historical illustration inset, not present-day boats.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: Minha família fala de três barcos perdidos.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: É memória valiosa, mas não prova de hoje.

pages.title: Marca recente, mão ausente
pages.layout: close stone study with clear speaker portraits
pages.scene: Talin LEFT examines modern-looking tool grooves in the basalt without crossing the limit; Ysra RIGHT states she saw marks but not whoever made them.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: O sulco novo merece exame.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: Eu vi a marca. Não vi a mão.

pages.title: Algo na água
pages.layout: impact creature panel with safe dry route visible
pages.scene: Sere LEFT sees a flattened gray four-limbed heat-hunting creature cling to a stone at the shallow seam; Pim RIGHT retreats along dry path, not trapped in water.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Pim, recue pela trilha seca!

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: Estou indo. A pedra ficou fria.

pages.title: Moradores primeiro
pages.layout: split doorway and port lane without duplicate people
pages.scene: Adra LEFT signals two barge crew to move nearby children into Hessa's inn; Hessa RIGHT holds the door and counts occupied rooms, keeping locals in the scene.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Crianças para dentro. Cais livre para recuo.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: Vou conferir cada quarto e a rua.

pages.title: Ar errado
pages.layout: dynamic low-angle sand action, two speakers
pages.scene: Caio LEFT tries guiding existing air toward the creature but sand lashes his own leg; Sere RIGHT orders him to stop near Pim and the dry exit. No magic tornado or extra people.

lines.speaker: Caio
lines.text: A corrente virou em mim!

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Pare. Aqui o vento leva areia aos feridos.

pages.title: Um caminho de água
pages.layout: asymmetric water-and-lantern composition
pages.scene: Runa LEFT pours a real jar of water into a safe side groove, steering a thin flow away from houses; Tovo RIGHT places his lit oil lantern on a gravel circle, away from straw, as the creature follows warmth.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Levo a água para o sulco vazio.

lines.speaker: Tovo
lines.text: A lamparina fica na pedra, longe da palha.

pages.title: Fonte anunciada
pages.layout: tense lantern foreground with safe retreat
pages.scene: Ilyan LEFT, long black wavy hair no beard, guides a small visible flame from the existing lantern wick no farther than a finger toward the creature; Sere RIGHT clearly points retreat route, sword sheathed until needed.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: A fonte é a mecha. Só um dedo de chama.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Rota de recuo à direita. Ninguém encurralado.

pages.title: Som de sal
pages.layout: diagonal action with wedge detail
pages.scene: Ysra LEFT strikes a small salt stone against larger stone, producing a sharp sound; Talin RIGHT braces a loose wedge from his authorized side with the end of a staff; flattened gray creature hesitates in midground.

lines.speaker: Ysra
lines.text: O som a faz hesitar.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Seguro a cunha sem abrir a passagem.

pages.title: Peso travado
pages.layout: wide calming reflection and block inset
pages.scene: Adra LEFT braces a loosened weight from the dry public mark with a wooden block, no crossing; Runa RIGHT watches real water return to reflection of true trees as creature slips away alive or unconfirmed.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: A madeira segura o peso por agora.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Ela recuou. Não sabemos se morreu.

pages.title: Vigia e saída
pages.layout: warm night inn with watch-list inset
pages.scene: At the occupied inn dusk, Adra LEFT posts a two-person watch roster, water jars and marked exit; Hessa RIGHT answers a worried child just inside doorway while keeping child's face unobscured.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Teremos vigia dupla, água e saída marcada.

lines.speaker: Hessa
lines.text: Prometer segurança absoluta seria mentir.

pages.title: A primeira volta
pages.time: Dia 498 · manhã, após exame à distância
pages.layout: departure quay with instrument bundles
pages.scene: Pim LEFT boards first return barge with instruments and copied records, his healed rope hand protected; Adra RIGHT confirms that Hessa keeps original ledger and second group crosses next day.

lines.speaker: Pim
lines.text: Levo as medidas. O livro de Hessa fica.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Amanhã cruzamos com as testemunhas.

pages.narration: No dia 497, registraram de longe a cunha, a lama e o musgo, sem retirar material nem atribuir autoria. Na manhã seguinte, começou a viagem de volta.

pages.title: Fatos e hipóteses
pages.layout: archive desk with two labeled stacks but no legible generated text
pages.scene: Back at established school's records room after ordinary west-to-east barge crossing, Ordelia LEFT separates copied creature description from guesses about origin; Eda RIGHT opens a limited margin safety inquiry and prepares Maelor notification.

lines.speaker: Ordelia
lines.text: Descrição aqui. Hipóteses em outra pasta.

lines.speaker: Eda
lines.text: Notifico Maelor. Silêncio não é confissão.

pages.title: Regressar importa
pages.layout: quiet intimate wide observatory with city lights
pages.scene: Runa LEFT and Ilyan RIGHT at established school observatory window above Valecobre, both adult and physically unchanged; her drawing of seam rests closed; they choose evidence and safe return over forcing a route for Mira.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Quero saber o que Mira viu. Não abrirei a costura por isso.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Nem vou pedir. Precisamos conseguir voltar.
